freePlan.limits: Fully free and open source, no paid tier

keyLimits.en: Free React (and Angular/Vue variants) component library, no paid tier or hosted service.

capabilities.en: Large set of ready-made React UI components for enterprise applications.
Theme customization via CSS-in-JS with several pre-built themes.
Companion ecosystem: Ant Design Mobile, AntV data visualization, and a design toolkit (Kitchen).
Ports available for Angular and Vue in addition to the primary React library.

limitations.en: No official paid support tier; support relies on the open-source community and GitHub issues.
Visual style is distinctly opinionated (enterprise/admin-panel look), which requires real customization work to diverge from.

reason.en: Direct competitor: another free, opinionated React component library for building application UIs.

missingAlternatives.name: Chakra UI
missingAlternatives.reason: Widely used alternative React component library, not in the catalogue.

unknowns: No dedicated pricing page exists since the product is fully open source; commercial/enterprise support offerings (if any) were not found on the homepage.
